CS 348 — Introduction to Database Management
Fall 2026 Course Syllabus

Instructor: Dr. Ada Lovelace
Email: alovelace@university.edu
Office Hours: Tuesdays 2-4pm, DC 3512

Course Description
This course introduces the fundamentals of database management systems,
including the relational model, SQL, schema design, and transactions.

Grading Breakdown
Assignments: 40%
Midterm Exam: 25%
Final Exam: 30%
Participation: 5%

Course Schedule

Assignment 1 due September 25, 2026
Quiz 1 in class on October 2, 2026
Assignment 2 due October 16, 2026
Midterm Exam — October 22, 2026, covers chapters 1-6 (25%)
Assignment 3 due November 6, 2026
Project Milestone — around Week 10
Quiz 2 in class on November 20, 2026
Final Project presentation due December 4, 2026
Term Paper due date TBD
Final Exam — scheduled by the registrar, December 14, 2026

Readings
Chapter 3 reading due September 18, 2026

Policies
